run_torchrun_elastic_training: run elastic distributed training with torchrun using configurable node ranges and max restarts
run_torchrun_standalone_training: run single-node multi-worker distributed training with torchrun standalone rendezvous backend
run_torchrun_fault_tolerant: run fault-tolerant distributed training with torchrun tolerating worker failures and automatic restarts
parse_torchrun_arguments: parse torchrun command-line arguments including node counts, process per node, and rendezvous configuration
determine_local_world_size: determine the number of local workers per node from nproc_per_node supporting auto, gpu, cpu, and custom backends
